title: Utilities and Graph
summary: This module aggregates foundational utilities, including a graph processing framework for complex workflows, tools for documentation generation, and scripts for testing and cloud integration verification.

nodes.label: Graph Processing Core
nodes.title: Graph Execution Framework
nodes.description: Provides a robust framework for defining, executing, and managing complex workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or state machines.

nodes.label: Documentation Build Tools
nodes.title: MkDocs Documentation Utilities
nodes.description: Enhances the MkDocs documentation generation process with features like code snippet injection, Algolia search indexing, and environment configuration.

nodes.label: Scripts & Testing Utilities
nodes.title: Development & Testing Tools
nodes.description: Contains various scripts for VCR cassette management, CLI behavior verification, and integration testing with cloud services like Google Cloud.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Core
nodes.title: Main AI Agent Framework
nodes.description: The central framework for building and running AI agents, which can leverage graph processing for complex orchestrations.

nodes.label: External Documentation System
nodes.title: MkDocs & Algolia
nodes.description: The external systems (MkDocs, Algolia) that consume the output and are configured by the documentation tools.

nodes.label: External Cloud Platforms
nodes.title: Cloud Services (GCS, Vertex AI)
nodes.description: Cloud providers and services (e.g., Google Cloud Storage, Vertex AI) that are targeted and verified by the testing scripts.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Graph Processing

groups.label: Documentation Support
